records.name: Kaelvar
records.originalSummary: A northwestern continent of dry interior uplands, fertile southern coasts, and island-studded northern waters.
records.proposedSummary: A northwestern continent with dry inland uplands, fertile southern coasts and an island-studded northern maritime fringe facing the intercontinental trading seas.
records.reason: Maintain approved northwest placement while avoiding implicit old child-polygon authority.

records.name: Valtherion
records.originalSummary: The largest and most fertile landmass, dominated by major rivers, forested northlands, and vast agricultural basins.
records.proposedSummary: The largest northeastern supercontinent, with vast river basins, forested northern lands and fertile agricultural heartlands facing the Myridian and northern seas.
records.reason: Preserve greatest landmass and river-basin ecology; Dawnreach stays separate.

records.name: Serathyl
records.originalSummary: A long maritime continent of complex coasts, forested interiors, and merchant-friendly sea lanes.
records.proposedSummary: A southwestern maritime continent of forested interiors, intricate coasts and long-distance western trade routes.
records.reason: Preserve independent southwestern marine/forest identity without implying Windward land on Kaelvar.

records.name: Draemor
records.originalSummary: A fertile southern central continent defined by large river systems and powerful agricultural belts.
records.proposedSummary: A fertile south-central continent of broad rivers and agricultural basins, linked to Talmyra by a jointly managed natural tidal-rock land crossing.
records.reason: Retain wet-temperate agrarian identity; add normally passable overland contact without inventing executable route geometry.

records.name: Talmyra
records.originalSummary: A wilder southeastern continent of tribal confederacies, volcanic strongholds, jungled interiors, and contested frontiers.
records.proposedSummary: A hot, seasonal and rugged southeastern continent of tropical forests, savanna, resource-rich uplands and frontier valleys, connected to Draemor by a jointly managed tidal-rock isthmus.
records.reason: Preserve independent tropical frontier ecology, complementary trade and normal overland access.

records.name: The Myridian Chain
records.originalSummary: A busy archipelago between Kaelvar and Valtherion made up of pirate states, trade ports, and naval staging points.
records.proposedSummary: A northern intercontinental island network and naval-oriented trade power between Kaelvar and Valtherion, including a detached central island amid contested commercial approaches and independently sovereign neighboring merfolk waters.
records.reason: Align parent-level detached island assignment and maritime rivalry without attributing underwater sovereignty.

records.name: The Lantern Isles
records.originalSummary: Small central-ocean islands used as trade outposts, hidden anchorages, and pirate refuges.
records.proposedSummary: A warm-water, east-central maritime island network whose trading ports compete with Myridian and link the southern continents to the eastern seas.
records.reason: Make central/eastern trade sphere explicit; new token is a proposed label, not approved schema.

records.name: The Serpent's Wake
records.originalSummary: A storm-lashed southern island arc infamous for pirate tribes, wrecking seas, and undersea kingdoms.
records.proposedSummary: A remote eastern island confederation of traders, local authorities, maritime guilds and private patrols, renowned for reefs, tourism and seaborne commerce while concealing some privateering and piracy.
records.reason: Replace obsolete southern/pirate-dominated shorthand with approved eastern confederation.

records.name: The Dawnreach Isles
records.originalSummary: Sparse eastern islands far from the main continental centers, valuable mainly as waypoints and remote outposts.
records.proposedSummary: A remote northern U-shaped arctic and subarctic archipelago of rugged cold islands, winter ice, sheltered inner waters and cold-water maritime settlements.
records.reason: Owner-selected Option 2, northern polar identity, not old far-eastern geography.

note: The new summaries and optional position-label tokens are editorial proposals requiring owner/source acceptance and field/schema validation before canonical integration.
